landing.rolesSubtitle: Pick your role and we will show what matters to you.
landing.roleOwnerBody: Follow your units, leases and payments in one place.
landing.roleTenantBody: Record the unit's condition at move-in and raise maintenance requests with photos.
landing.roleManagerBody: Shared expenses with their receipts, and a clear balance for every owner.
landing.roleBrokerBody: A timestamped record of clients and viewings, and ad checks before you publish.
landing.howTitle: Three steps to a documented property
landing.step1Body: Add the building and units, and link each unit to an Ejar contract number.
landing.step2Body: Room by room, with photos and both parties' sign-off, each stamped with time and location.
landing.step3Body: Payments, maintenance and renewals, then a comparison report ready to attach in Ejar.
landing.recordBody: Everything that happens to the property is recorded with its date: construction, insurance, inspections, maintenance, renewals. If ownership changes, the record moves with your consent.
landing.ev1Detail: Room-by-room inspection, signed by owner and tenant.
landing.ev2Detail: Ticket closed with before and after photos.
landing.ev3Detail: Reminder to both parties sixty days before the lease ends.
landing.insightsBody: Neighborhood prices and rents from official open data, shown as indicative figures, not an official valuation. And a helper that reminds you of Riyadh's rent freeze and the renewal-notice date.
landing.insightsSoon: Neighborhood indicators will appear here in a later release.
landing.trust1Title: Your data stays in the Kingdom
landing.trust1Body: Account data and records are stored in a data center in Dammam.
landing.trust2Body: We collect only what is needed to run your account, and you can export or delete your data.
landing.trust3Body: It does not replace Ejar contracts, deposits or the official handover form. It documents what surrounds them.
landing.footerNote: Rasikh is a support tool. It does not provide legal advice or official valuations.
landing.heroCaption: Every lit window is a documented home.
